concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-premium-fraud-management-tools-client-side-javascript-v3]] - JavaScript v3 custom and Drop-in device-data collection, merchant-server handoff, conditional FraudNet race callback and automatic-vault verification warning; an umbrella Premium Fraud Management Tools integration route, not named-product behavior
warnings: Keep this as a purpose-and-navigation route: the source does not identify an enabled named Premium Fraud Management Tool or establish any named product's capabilities, eligibility, decisions, liability treatment or bypass behavior.

The existing concept distinguishes Basic Fraud Tools from premium-product behavior; adding this reciprocal route must not erase that boundary or imply that device-data collection makes the named products interchangeable.
Preserve the JavaScript v3 client-side and 2026-09-16 snapshot scope, including the distinction between collecting or returning deviceData and the merchant server actually using it.
Preserve the automatic-vault warning: the new payment method's verification is evaluated without device data, although subsequent transactions can still pass it.
